title: Solving a linear inequality
subject: Math
learningGoal: Solve inequalities like ax + b < c and know when to flip the sign.
spokenLines: Solving a linear inequality is a lot like solving an equation.
Take negative two x plus three, less than eleven.
Subtract three from both sides. Negative two x is less than eight.
Now divide by negative two. Flip the sign when dividing by a negative.
So x is greater than negative four.
On a number line, open circle at negative four, shaded to the right.
